currentParagraphText: “Me... treasure,” Jasper said after drinking the potion, making Jake notice what the Shimmerfur was holding.

finalResult.nextParagraphText: Between his small paws, Jasper held a weird multi-colored crystal about the size of a fist that gave off an odd and unsettling aura. Jake had been too busy looking at Jasper’s state at first to notice it, but now that he was looking at it, Jake knew it wasn’t anything simple.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “Jasper, what the hell happened?” Jake said as he hurried to take out a health potion and force-fed the little guy.
